variant: illustrative conductance adaptation, fixed hypothesis; NOT fitted/calibrated biology
adaptation_current_at_voltage: g_adapt_uS * (EA_mV - V_mV) gives nA; this is state dependent, not an independent adaptation-current state
matching_point: increment .002/15uS yields -.002nA at V=-65mV and EA=-80mV only; matching this one point does not calibrate whole dynamics
source_parameter_compatibility: net.p retains frozen original ConductanceParams values including adaptation_increment_nA .002 and adaptation_tau_ms100 as SOURCE METADATA. The active adaptation mechanism uses net.adaptation_params. No net.adaptation field exists; g_adapt is never mislabeled as nA.

synapses.normalization: raw source synapse count divided by sum raw strict incoming counts at each post, across excitation and inhibition together
synapses.receptor_assumption: ACh excitatory/GABA+glutamate inhibitory illustrative; not receptor measurement; unknown/mixed inactive

discretization.voltage: backward Euler with frozen start conductances
discretization.conductance_decay: exact exp(-dt/tau) after end-step threshold and reset; g_adapt increment follows decay
discretization.spike_delay: end-step emit, interval-start receive exactly2ms later

prior_failure_status: The185910Z current-adaptation calibration and -90mV engineering-bound failures remain valid historical evidence. This is a separate mechanistic hypothesis, not threshold reinterpretation.
